id: \rJessie: Let's take care of this quickly.
en: \rJessie: Let's take care of this quickly.

id: \bMeowth: Alright you guys, the boss gave us an important job! We can't screw this up!
en: \bMeowth: Alright you guys, the boss gave us an important job! We can't screw this up!
it: \bMeowth: Forza, ragazzi, il capo ci ha affidato un incarico importante! Non possiamo mandare tutto all'aria!

id: \bGary: I tried to beat them. Their Pokémon are just too strong.
en: \bGary: I tried to beat them. Their Pokémon are just too strong.
it: \bGary: Ho provato a batterli. I loro Pokémon sono semplicemente troppo forti.

id: \bGiovanni: I leave this battle to you three. I'm sure you can handle it.\n...\nOn second thought, take some of my Pokémon.
en: \bGiovanni: I leave this battle to you three. I'm sure you can handle it.\n...\nOn second thought, take some of my Pokémon.
it: \bGiovanni: Lascio a voi tre questa lotta. Sono sicuro che ve la caverete.\n...\nRipensandoci, prendete alcuni dei miei Pokémon.

id: \bMeowth: You idiots! The Gym is collapsing!
en: \bMeowth: You idiots! The Gym is collapsing!

id: \bJames: What are we standing around for? Let's get out of here!
en: \bJames: What are we standing around for? Let's get out of here!
it: \bJames: Che ci facciamo ancora qui impalati? Filiamocela!
